title: Snow Safety Check Beacon Battery Leaderboard
dataSources: Slopes ski sessions (`slopes:session`), Ski Tracks runs (`skitracks:run`), OnTheSnow resort reports (`onthesnow:report`), snow safety checks (`snow:safety`), and Ikon Pass lift scans (`ikon:pass`).
app: Slopes ski sessions, Ski Tracks GPS runs, OnTheSnow resort reports, snow safety checklist logs, and Ikon Pass scan exports forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=snow:safety beacon_battery_pct=*
| stats sum(beacon_battery_pct) as total_value, avg(beacon_battery_pct) as avg_value by checklist_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks checklist values by total and average beacon battery across snow safety check events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `beacon_battery_pct` values for each snow safety check event and review total and average beacon battery by checklist.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total beacon battery.
grandmaExplanation: It produces which checklist shows the biggest beacon battery numbers in your snow safety check data.
